d:
Karnataka government tests have claimed excess ethanol in several petrol samples.
One IOCL sample reportedly contained 31.2% ethanol, while an HPCL sample had 30.5%.
Rahul Gandhi has questioned the Centre over the alleged excess ethanol blending.
IOCL, BPCL and HPCL have disputed the findings and questioned the testing procedure.
The oil companies have called for joint and transparent re-testing of the samples.
